note: PROPOSAL ONLY (not merged; owner decision). Strong derived-substance marker, CLASSIFICATION-BEARING. Source: NUPENS 'Food classification Nova' page (nupens.fsp.usp.br/en/food-classification-nova/), Group 4 paragraph, a NOVA method source read in full; Lancet 2025 (USP-hosted PDF) names plant protein isolates. Texturized soy protein as an instance of 'protein isolates or concentrates' is an INFERENCE (extruded soy protein concentrate/flour), not stated by the source.

clause.where: NUPENS, Food classification Nova (nupens.fsp.usp.br/en/food-classification-nova/), Group 4 paragraph
clause.text: These substances include sugar, oils, and fats for domestic use, protein isolates or concentrates, interesterified oils, hydrogenated fat, modified starches, and various substances for exclusive industrial use.

basis.where: NUPENS, Food classification Nova, Group 4 paragraph
basis.text: Ultra-processed foods – which can be foods and drinks – are not really foods but formulations of substances obtained by fractionating foods from the first group.
